name: Sincerely, Robin
detailed_description:
Sincerely, Robin is our upcoming management, cooking, and narrative game set in a world of birds! Play as Robin and return to your hometown to regrow the bed and breakfast left to you by your late grandfather. Cook meals for your guests, engage with the community, and forge lasting relationships with the birds that come to stay!

The full game is currently in development -- follow our social media to keep up with our development journey! You can find an INITIAL DEMO on Steam as Bed and BEAKfast.

By downloading this game, you will be able to:

  • Explore the B&B tree and surrounding shops in the town of Arboro

  • Interact with the Arboro residents and B&B guests, all with unique personalities

  • Craft dishes based on flavor profiles to serve to your guests, each of whom has different preferences

  • Expand your B&B by adding more branches and rooms to accommodate extra guests

  • Support and reconnect the community by progressing the story, learning about its residents' lives and bringing them closer together

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+), Windows 10 and Windows 11
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support.
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 capable.
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Sound Card That Makes Music
